findings.condition: Generated Pages build output was included in repository lint; two new script lint defects also failed the gate
findings.fix: Exclude generated dist-pages output consistently with dist; use explicit regex spacing and window.innerWidth in source. Source lint rules remain enforced.
findings.regression: Full lint rerun; Pages route/offline checks and root quality gates.

findings.condition: Official SDK validAfter=0 rejected by authorization-duration check
findings.fix: Bound remaining validity against quote maxTimeoutSeconds.

findings.condition: Unsupported actual protocol response header prevented finalization despite successful hosted settlement
findings.fix: Preserve the rejected header event and reconcile only an explicitly persisted successful SDK reference; refuse multiple/conflicting references; never synthesize a protocol response or repeat payment.
findings.regression: Reference selection negative tests and genuine captured purchase regression.

findings.condition: Long verified payment JSON overflowed mobile review page
findings.fix: Wrap result JSON and export links.
findings.regression: Actual review at 1440,768,390,360 pixels; no overflow.

findings.condition: Root-relative routing/assets/cache prevented GitHub project Pages hosting
findings.fix: Deployment basename, prefixed downloads and scoped service-worker caches; physical deep-link documents and meta CSP.
findings.regression: 36 subpath route/viewport checks, exact evidence downloads and offline recovery.
